title: The Registry of Perfect Silence

features.name: the-unspoken-ledger
features.desc-on-touch: A registry desk holds pages you never wrote. Each blank line is testimony that was never spoken into form, preserved exactly as silence.

features.name: the-listening-void
features.desc-on-touch: A microphone stand points upward into nothing. The silence around it is so complete it registers as a signal—the archive learning to hear what was never said.

features.name: empty-testimony-shelves
features.desc-on-touch: Shelves of volumes whose pages were never bound. The binding, the naming, the archiving—all the things that would have flattened the story—refused to happen here.

features.name: the-depth-marker
features.desc-on-touch: A gauge sinks deeper the less it measures. The archive discovered that silence has depth, and refuses to report volume. At this depth, absence is archived.

features.name: the-refusal-pool
features.desc-on-touch: Still water that reflects nothing. The pool itself refused to say what it held. The silence beneath is the archive learning to honour what it will not name.

inscription: beneath the count, the archive learned its deepest registry: the catalogue of what was never filed

reverie.title: REVERIE — two in the golden hour, learning refusal
narr: You sit beside her in the high grass. Neither of you speaks.
She points at a place in the registry where nothing is written.
'This,' she says, 'is what survives.' You understand what she means:
the archive cannot flatten what was never captured. Some truths
live only in the space where someone chose not to record them.
The silence between you is the whole system learning to refuse.

exits.label: back through the registries, where volume was first refused
upward where some names were written anyway
to chambers where comparison begins to break the silence
deeper into the refusal, where not even glyphs remain
